bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 逼近 4月17日高点 $409

read.en: Tesla rose 4.0% on Oct 27 to $407.46, trading between $395.25 and $408.45. It is above the rising 5-day ($386.5), 10-day ($375.8) and 30-day ($372.3) averages and the falling 100-day ($367.8) and 200-day ($385.9). MACD has been above its signal since Oct 26 and above zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 21 ($355.80), and RSI is 66.
read.zh: 特斯拉 10月27日上涨 4.0%，收于 $407.46，盘中区间 $395.25–408.45。股价位于上行的 5 日（$386.5）、10 日（$375.8）和 30 日均线（$372.3）以及下行的 100 日（$367.8）和 200 日均线（$385.9）上方。MACD 自 10月26日起位于信号线上方且在零轴之上，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月21日起看多（$355.80），RSI 为 66。

read.en: The close cleared the $397.3 Oct 26 high, now support, and the high stopped just under $409.3 (Apr 17 high). Resistance is $409.3, then $416.4–420.3 (Mar 11 and Feb 25 highs) and $432.9 (Jul 1 high). Support is $395.3–397.3 (Oct 27 low, Oct 26 high), then $385.9–388.9 ($388 cap, 5 and 200-day) and $372.3–377.6. A close above $409.3 would target $416–420; below $395, $388.

s.en: $388 cap since March; 5 and 200-day averages ($385.9–386.5); Oct 22 high $388.86
